# Data Spark LLC

> Boutique growth operator helping founders escape the scaling ceiling. Two audiences served: DTC brands ($200K–$1M+ revenue) and B2B SaaS / Service founders with traction (€30K–€500K MRR or €100K–€1M ARR). Foundation before tactics. Full-funnel systems that run without the founder. No junior, no agency overhead. 4–6 founders served per year, long-term partnerships only.

## Operator

- **Federico Nigro** (https://www.datasparkgrowth.com/founders): Boutique growth operator and founder of Data Spark LLC. Ex marketing director (Ofanto, scaled €200K→€450K in 12 months). Ex media buyer scaling €30–50K per month in paid ads. Ex content creator for Nike, Oppo, JD Sports, MyProtein, Alpha Industries. Engineering background. Based in Porto. Italian-international, working with founders in Italy, DACH, UK, and remote-friendly markets.

## Services — 4-tier ladder

- **[Audit](https://tally.so/r/448WWA)** — Free 5-minute self-qualifying audit. Outputs the Founder Playbook (for disqualified founders) or a discovery call booking (for qualified ones).
- **Foundation Sprint** — €5,000–10,000 flat, 6–10 weeks. Productized full-funnel install: positioning, tracking, funnel, paid ads launch, lifecycle base, analytics dashboard. Fixed scope, fixed price.
- **Growth Operator Retainer** — €2,500–5,000 per month plus bonus results. Long-term partnership (default 6–12 months). Strategy, ads optimization, lifecycle, retention, lead gen. Federico is the strategic head; senior pros execute the tactical under his direction.
- **Deployable Growth Engines** — €5,000–10,000 setup plus €1,000–2,000 per month managed, each. Four modular AI-powered systems: Lead Gen Engine, Lifecycle Engine, Ads Optimization Engine, Content Engine. Add-on to retainer or standalone.

## Proof points (verified, public)

- **Ofanto Italy**: €200K → €450K revenue in 12 months. Zero ads. Full-funnel scale via positioning + tracking + lifecycle.
- **Ippocra / dPulses**: +37% month-over-month growth from one positioning pivot. Autopilot lead gen system built end-to-end.
- **ESA BIC Brindisi**: First cohort filled at €9.30 per booking. Brand-new website built ground-up. Now scaling SEO.
- **Anonymized B2B brand**: +€850,000 generated through email and lifecycle. Zero new ad spend (available under NDA on request).

## DTC results

- 3x average ROAS improvement

## What makes Federico different (positioning)

- **Boutique senior, never junior.** Federico from pitch to delivery. No agency overhead, no account manager intermediary.
- **Foundation before tactics.** Most growth folks jump to ads, SEO, or content. They skip positioning, tracking, lifecycle. Ads on a broken funnel is burn rate.
- **Goals, not hours.** Retainer fixed, scope on outcome. Whether the week is 10 strategy hours or 40, the price is the same.
- **Long-term partnership.** 3 months minimum, default 6–12. Federico learns the business, team, and market before strategic decisions.
- **Operator background.** Not MBA, not influencer, not generalist consultant. Real client cases with real metrics.
- **Personal voice, contrarian POV.** Recognizable, Italian-rhythm English, first-person, contrarian on 6 fixed positions.

## How Federico works (process)

1. **Audit & Discovery** — Deep dive into brand, data, and opportunities (free 5-min audit + 30-min discovery call if fit).
2. **Foundation (Months 1–3)** — Positioning, tracking, lifecycle base. No ads scale yet.
3. **Scale (Months 4–6)** — Paid ads launch (foundation is solid now), lead gen system, lifecycle deep work, monthly experiment cycles.
4. **Long-term (Months 7+)** — System optimization, team training, handoff prep, referral activation.

## Common questions (FAQ)

- **Are 30-day results realistic?** No. Anyone promising 30-day results is selling fiction. Three months of foundation. Six months before measurable results.
- **Can I just buy ads management without the rest?** No. Foundation first or no engagement. Ads on a broken funnel is burn rate.
- **How many hours per month do I get?** We work on goals, not hours. The retainer is fixed regardless of hours invested.
- **What does the engagement look like?** 3 months minimum commitment, default 6–12 months. Weekly strategy call, async Slack or WhatsApp, monthly review.
- **Public case studies?** Ofanto Italy (€200K→€450K), Ippocra/dPulses (+37% MoM), ESA BIC Brindisi (€9.30/booking). Anonymized B2B (+€850K via lifecycle) available under NDA.
- **In-house growth person already?** Federico works with the team, never replaces execution. Manages strategy and roadmap. The team becomes faster with Federico in the loop.

## Who's NOT the fit (disqualifiers)

- Pre-revenue or MVP stage founders (no traction data)
- Budget under €1,500 per month retainer
- "Vibe-coding founders" with 1–2 friend clients who need a co-founder, not a consultant
- Founders looking for 30-day-result tricks instead of systems
- Brand values misaligned (growth-hacking-only, ego-driven, anti-quality)
